messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off Everbright dedicated bring-up. Goal: quota provisioning + autoscale smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need eng + SRE on-call for 09:00-09:30. Link to plan: https://redwood.internal/everbright/bringup :rocket:
aj-eng: Got it. Can you drop the traffic profile and preferred target qps? Also want to confirm model / sequence length for batching expectations.
maria_cs: Traffic profile attached in the doc. Primary target: 800 qps steady, 1200 qps burst for 5m. Model: rdx-13b, seq 256 typical.
sam-solutions: Recommend enabling prefix KV caching for their common prompts and a 50ms batching window during steady state to keep latency SLAs. Will add config snippets.
leo-sre: Which GPU family for the reserved pool? Need to pin (A10x / H100) to ensure perf consistency. Also request for slot reservations + fallback policy if pool saturated.
maria_cs: Everbright requested T4-equivalent in contract but engineering prefers A10x for initial soak. Contract team ok to bump. I'll confirm. Fallback: route to shared-hosted low-latency model variant if reserved pool drops below 60% capacity.
dinesh-customer: We can run a shadow generator from our infra and replay historical traffic at 09:00. I will trigger our test harness and report back.
aj-eng: Sharing a quick load generator command we'll use on our side for the smoke:
```
./loadgen --target 1200 --model rdx-13b --seq 256 --qps-profile burst:5m@1200,steady:25m@800 --concurrency 200 --duration 30m
```
aj-eng: Also set header X-Redwood-Test: everbright-shadow so routing rules treat it as non-billable.
ops-bot: Ticket #CS-2489 created for Everbright bring-up window and linked to runbook RB-54. Assigned: leo-sre, aj-eng, sam-solutions.
leo-sre: On the routing side, will add a canary rule to steer 10% of traffic to the fallback variant for first 10m. If errors > 1% we rollback to hosted.
sam-solutions: Prep note: prime KV prefixes with 500 warm calls per shard, then run the steady qps. Saves cold-start token cost. I'll push a priming script to the doc.
maria_cs: Timeline reminder: 08:30 internal check, 08:45 priming, 09:00 start shadow + loadgen, 09:15 smoke verification, 09:30 postmortem quick sync.
dinesh-customer: Starting priming from our side at 08:45 UTC-7. We'll stream logs to the thread.
aj-eng: If anyone sees 429/503, paste the header dump. We want to know if it's QPS limit or slot exhaustion.
dinesh-customer: 09:01 — first shadow run: getting a few 403 QuotaExceeded from the reserved pool. Header shows x-rdw-quota: allocated=0.
leo-sre: Aha — looks like quota not provisioned in region us-west-2 due to billing delay. Maria, can you confirm reservation was applied?
maria_cs: Working on it now with finance. Pinged billing + partner ops.
ina-billing: (joined) I see the pending invoice for Everbright; approving now. Should flush through in ~3 min.
dinesh-customer: 09:05 — repeating shadow run after 3m, errors dropped to 0.2% at 1200 burst. Latency p50 ~120ms, p95 ~320ms.
aj-eng: Nice. We see warm KV hit rate ~82% after priming. Batching average latency impact +12ms.
sam-solutions: Observability check: token cost per request roughly matches projection within 6%. Rolling to canary 10% now.
leo-sre: Canary 10% steady for 10m looks stable. Increasing to 40% burst window and monitoring.
maria_cs: Customer reports app smoke-green. Dinesh — any qualitative feedback from their UX team?
dinesh-customer: UX team saw consistent completions and no timeouts. Small artifact in very long sequences but acceptable for initial rollout.
aj-eng: We've captured a small regression with very long sequences >512 where kv cache misses spike. Flagging for next sprint.
maria_cs: Great — proceeding with handoff to onboarding ops. Postmortem at 10:00 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
